2607.02903.title: TIER: Trajectory-Invariant Explanation Regularization for Membership Privacy
2607.02903.paper_summary: Explainability is central to building trustworthy AI, yet explanation interfaces can inadvertently provide adversaries with an expanded privacy-related attack surfaces. Recent studies show that advanced membership-inference attacks succeed by exploiting confidence-drop trajectories, induced through attribution-guided perturbations, as discriminative features, rather than directly using confidence scores or explanation vectors. Existing defenses against membership inference fail to directly mitigate such explanation-driven attacks. In this work, we investigate whether, during training, a model's own gradients can be leveraged as defense signals against such attacks, thereby aligning explanation profiles between members and non-members. To this end, we propose a Trajectory-Invariant Explanation Regularization (TIER) defense that penalizes erratic fluctuations in confidence drops simulated through gradient-guided perturbations and simultaneously minimizes the distributional shifts via KL-divergence. Unlike conventional adversarial training, which emphasizes label robustness, our approach targets explanation robustness by enforcing self-consistency through KL-divergence and reducing the variance of confidence drops between members and non-members. Extensive experiments confirm that our method effectively mitigates these attacks, delivering privacy protection while maintaining model utility and explanation fidelity.
2607.02903.paper_summary_zh: 解釋性對於建立可信的人工智慧至關重要，然而解釋介面可能無意中為對手提供擴大的隱私相關攻擊面。最近的研究顯示，先進的成員推斷攻擊通過利用信心下降的軌跡來成功，這些軌跡是通過歸因引導的擾動所引起的，作為區分特徵，而不是直接使用信心分數或解釋向量。現有的對抗成員推斷的防禦措施未能直接減輕這種以解釋為驅動的攻擊。在本研究中，我們調查在訓練過程中，模型自身的梯度是否可以作為對抗這類攻擊的防禦信號，從而使成員和非成員之間的解釋輪廓保持一致。為此，我們提出了一種軌跡不變解釋正則化（TIER）防禦，該防禦通過梯度引導的擾動模擬的信心下降中的不穩定波動進行懲罰，同時通過KL散度最小化分佈變化。與傳統的對抗性訓練強調標籤穩健性不同，我們的方法通過強制自我一致性來針對解釋穩健性，並減少成員和非成員之間信心下降的變異性。廣泛的實驗確認我們的方法能有效減輕這些攻擊，在維護模型效用和解釋真實性的同時提供隱私保護。
